anya: Quick postmortem follow-up — we captured several vendor-related mitigations. need owners + deadlines. keep answers short.

matt: I can take multi-region health gating + staged DNS failover. prototype in staging in 5 business days, canary in next sprint. owner: matt.

sara: I'll own model-registry resilience: local artifact cache, tighter download token TTLs, and latency metrics. runbook draft by Friday. owner: sara.

tim: I will do auth SDK hardening: circuit breaker, verification-only fallback, and rotation monitoring. prototype this week. do we want fallback stored encrypted or ephemeral in-memory?

anya: prefer encrypted KMS-wrapped fallback (reduces ops friction) unless team says strong objection.

lucy: ops will add composite alerts and an on-call playbook entry. target next Wed. owner: lucy.

matt: cloud MVM proposal: health gating + traffic-shift script + small capacity budget for warmups.

sara: registry MVM: local cache with soft-ttl 10m + instrument errors.

tim: auth MVM: basic circuit breaker + verification-only fallback behind a feature flag.

anya: consensus MVM = matt/sara/tim. target: 10 days for MVM. I'll reserve sprint capacity and run weekly 15m check-ins.

infra-bot: matt deployed infra/health-gating:staging at 2210043288 by matt — status: success.

anya: thanks all. update the postmortem tracker with owners, deadlines, and acceptance criteria. ping this thread if blocked; otherwise weekly check-ins until closed. :v:
